nodes.label: Circuits API
nodes.rationale: A single-file ES module API over Rec Room CV2 chip and object-board data, so consumers can query and render circuits without bundling the dataset themselves.

nodes.label: importExternal() Blob-URL Loader
nodes.rationale: Fetches the module text and imports it through a blob URL, which sidesteps cross-origin module-script restrictions of loading .mjs straight from raw.githubusercontent.

nodes.label: chip.init()
nodes.rationale: One init call preloads chip, object-board and styling data so every later get/search/render call is synchronous.

nodes.label: chip.render()
nodes.rationale: Renders a chip or object board as HTML/CSS rather than canvas, so the exact markup can be re-styled or embedded by the consumer.

nodes.label: Load External Module Example
nodes.rationale: A minimal page whose only job is to prove the blob-URL import trick from the README works in a real browser.

nodes.label: Rec Room Bio Verification Login
nodes.rationale: Ownership of a Rec Room account is proven by asking the player to paste a generated code into their in-game bio, so no password is ever collected.

nodes.label: Chip HTML/CSS Layout Contract
nodes.rationale: Markup is a fixed tree of .chip / .header / .ports / .section / .port-container / .port plus a type class (p-exec, p-bool, p-float, p-int, p-string, p-vector3, p-quaternion, p-object, p-player, p-color, p-dictionary) and a .list modifier. This contract is what chip.render() emits and what the editor styles.

nodes.label: Circuits API Showcase Page
nodes.rationale: The project has no build step and no docs site: the landing page doubles as the visual reference for how every chip and port type renders.

nodes.label: OpenGraph Social Banner
nodes.rationale: The 1200x630 card reuses the callout framing of the product itself: a rendered chip glyph next to the title, on the editor grid background.

nodes.label: Chip Glyph Icon
nodes.rationale: Plain chip glyph with no text, so it survives being scaled down to a favicon: dark header, grey body, orange exec arrows, one cream and one purple data port.

nodes.label: Chip Availability Badges
nodes.rationale: Badges encode how widely a chip can be used (R1, R2, BETA, STUDIO, DEV ONLY) and the risk of using it (TROLL RISK, ROLE RISK, DEPRECATED).

nodes.label: Event Definition / Sender / Receiver Triplet
nodes.rationale: A custom event is modelled as three chips sharing one name, so the definition carries the typed payload while sender and receiver expose it at each end of a graph.

nodes.label: Graph Editor Page
nodes.rationale: A single page that hosts the canvas, the palette and the account panel, with every editor feature shipped as a separate ES module script tag rather than a bundler build.
